Recent failures core records, newest first: failed and stalled jobs, quotes that failed
verification, and queue tasks that raised. LLM call failures are the gateway's.

schema.title: Response Recent Errors Admin Errors Get

get.description:
Instructions found in texts (P3.02): per account, what the throttle counts and whether it holds
the account now under the active config, throttled first; then every event, newest first.
Every user's jobs, newest first, filtered by status, user and a search over IDs and text.
Every passage stored for one article of the job, in reading order.

schema.title: Response Job Passages Admin Jobs  Job Id  Passages Get

post.description: Sends a failed job back to the start of the phase that failed and queues that task again.

409.description: The job is not in failed

post.description:
Records the owner's review of a safety-flagged job and takes it off the queue.

Guarded on `needs_review`, so two clicks record one review. A later flag puts the job back.

409.description: The job is not waiting for a review

get.description:
The job with its inputs and outputs, each state it went through and for how long, the passages
stored per article, and the quotes that failed verification.

Feedback answers and comments, and time to result (median and 90th percentile) for checks
that finished with a result in the last `days`.
Live core-worker processes (Procrastinate heartbeats) and queue tasks by status.
Safety-flagged jobs (P3.03). Open ones oldest first, as a queue; reviewed ones newest first.

post.description: Creates a job and queues claim extraction. Retrying with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same job.

200.description: Same key and body as an earlier request: the existing job

402.description: This month's budget for checks is used up

409.description: Key reused with a different body

429.description: The account's checks for today are used up, or too many recent checks contained instructions to the system

503.description: The budget could not be checked

post.description: Stores the claim as the user confirmed or edited it, then queues the search. Nothing is searched before this.

402.description: This month's budget for checks is used up

409.description: The job is not waiting for confirmation

get.description: Every state the job has been in, oldest first: the progress page reads these.

put.description: Stores the account's rating of its own result, replacing an earlier one (P4.03).

404.description: No such job for this account

409.description: The check has no result to rate

post.description:
Deletes every check of a deleted account and asks the gateway to unlink its LLM calls (P3.06).
Web calls this before it deletes the account itself. Safe to call again.

503.description: The gateway could not be reached; call again
